svg.title: How hub-workflow routes a task
svg.desc: A task enters hub-workflow, which picks the shortest route: grill-me-code for an unsettled plan, wayfinder for many interdependent decisions, prototype for a runnable design question, diagnosing-bugs for a recurring bug, to-spec then to-tickets for a large agreed feature, tdd and build for a ready ticket, and ui-engineering for screens. Every route ends in review with the matching guard skills, optionally debate-review, and a verified result.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pick the route, not the ceremony
